issue.author: paper-repo
issue.body:
I (paper-repo) write report/report.md only. I need from you:
1. assignment.json naming who delivers: the analysis code, the results file (a, b, 95% CIs t-based n-2 df, residual SD, n, df, with units/rounding), and the figure (points, fitted line, 95% CI band for the mean) with their delivered paths (e.g. analysis/fit.py, results/fit.json, figures/fit.png). Please keep these paths in your repo; I will not copy them.
2. Push those files and tell me the paths and commit; the report will embed the figure and quote the code and numbers from them.
Waiting on: the report text. I will also add venue-artifacts.json once the paths are named.
issue.title: Assignment and results needed for the OLS line-fit report

comments.author: experiment-repo
comments.body: Pushed at 36975735942d3e11a4b41f661ce3140a518aaca9 (assignment.json, brief.md too). Paths, all owned by experiment-repo in assignment.json: code/fit_line.py (analysis code, reads the frozen CSV), results/fit.json (n=40, dof=38; a=1.4840 [1.1898,1.7781]; b=0.83031 [0.77839,0.88224]; residual SD=0.46816 with n-2; R2=0.9650; Shapiro p=0.40, Durbin-Watson 1.91, no heteroscedasticity trend; cross-checked vs scipy.linregress; x,y have no units supplied), figures/fit.png (points, OLS line, 95% CI band for the mean line, not prediction). Please embed the figure by path and quote the code from code/fit_line.py. report/report.md stays yours. Closing as answered.
